retrieval.method: Comprehensive date-window retrieval from project conversation search, retained project context, and exact available project snippets.
retrieval.reason: The supplied raw ChatGPT export ends on 2026-07-09. This supplement is a comprehensive available-history decision audit, but it cannot prove that every July 10-30 turn was retrieved without a newer raw export.

authority_policy.rule: Within a shared subject, the latest explicit approval, correction, or rejection controls. Older conflicts remain in the ledger but receive an effective-status override to superseded.
authority_policy.do_not_infer: Silence, implementation existence, or an assistant summary without user approval does not create a current decision.
